metadata.description: Two hundred years after the first colonists arrived, Mars is ruled by corporations and short of water. Zachariah, a Technomancer of the Abundance army, flees the secret police across the red planet with a band of companions, from the domes of Ophir to the Noctis slums, trading, fighting and deciding who to trust.
metadata.summary: A science-fiction RPG set on a hostile Mars.

metadata.description: Draw the subway map of a growing city. Stations appear, passengers wait, and every week you pick one upgrade to keep the lines from clogging.
A dead body possessed by a ball of cells fights its way through a shifting island, one run at a time. Nothing between runs survives but the blueprints you unlocked.
Jesse Faden walks into the Federal Bureau of Control looking for her brother and leaves the lobby as its new Director. The Oldest House shifts around her while the Hiss speaks through its staff.
Corvo Attano, bodyguard framed for the Empress's murder, takes to the rooftops of Dunwall with a blade, a mask and the Outsider's mark.
Faith runs messages across the rooftops of a city too clean to be honest, and the red paint on the pipes tells her where to go next.
Gotham's villains break out of Arkham in three gangs, and Batman and Robin chase them down brick by brick, in the one game where the villains get their own campaign.
Christmas Eve, a younger Batman, and eight assassins hired by Black Mask to end him before morning.

the-technomancer.title: The Noctis sewers
paragraphs: Zachariah goes down into the sewers under Noctis to find Amelia's contact. The mutants are more numerous than expected and the first encounter costs three heals.
- **Main quest:** Reached the sewers' second level and cleared the mutant nest under the market.
- **Side quest:** Found Amelia's contact, who wants a serum sample before talking.
The warrior style holds up better than before: the fully charged *electrified* staff drops the hounds in two hits. The shield skill has not been used yet.
The session ends on the way back to the surface, with Niesha arguing with Andrew at the camp.
the-technomancer.next_up: Talk to Amelia, then bring the serum back to the Abundance base before the secret police catch up with the group.

the-technomancer.title: Ophir, first night
paragraphs: Arrival in Ophir after the initiation. The dome is bigger than I remembered, and the Source market finally sells armour blueprints.
Two side quests done for Scott, a third abandoned: the guards of the officers' district will not let anyone through.
the-technomancer.next_up: Find a way into the officers' district.
